verdict.rationale: Formant documents fleet-wide monitoring from one place: 'instant visibility into every robot in your fleet' with anomaly alerts [formant-docs-5], 'one view across every vendor's fleet' [formant-docs-19], and managing 'multiple fleets simultaneously from a single operator view' [formant-docs-22]. It also tracks current location and status per robot [formant-docs-24] and supports building custom device dashboards [formant-docs-7]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (evidence is mostly vendor marketing pages), and detailed first-party docs on a fleet-level health/location map view.
